svg.text: PROPOSED CONSTRUCTION • Dimensions in mm • Orthographic • One shared master • Not creator approved
Source axes: X length / muzzle-forward, Y width, Z up. Front is viewed from +X; back from -X.
Overall X 1000.0 × Y 100.0 × Z 329.9 mm. All six panels use the same scale.

Grid: 100 mm. Clean PNG full-frame size: 1.250m square; 2048px. Raster pitch 0.610mm/px. Do not trace the dimensioned sheet as a scale image.
